_comment: Test-side map between the gstparse goldens (GStreamer codecparsers struct members, chapter 14 §14.4.2) and OVT's syntax trees, used by ovt_syntax_golden_run --oracle gstparse (WI-1.572). structs: golden structure key -> unit types that carry it. qualified_parents: members whose leaves are keyed '<parent>.<leaf>' (the same leaf name occurs under several parents). rename: '<structure>.<key>' -> OVT key, for GStreamer names that tools/gen_gst_fields.py RENAMES does not map. skip: '<structure>.<key>' -> why the member is not compared.
